text.en: Believing the Higgs mechanism gives mass to every particle in the Standard Model, including the photon and gluons — the photon and gluons remain genuinely massless; the Higgs mechanism is specifically what gives mass to the weak force's W and Z bosons (and, through a related coupling, to the fermions), not a universal mass-giving process applied to everything.
text.et: Arvamus, et Higgsi mehhanism annab massi igale standardmudeli osakesele, kaasa arvatud footonile ja gluoonidele — footon ja gluoonid jäävad tõeliselt massituteks; Higgsi mehhanism annab spetsiifiliselt massi nõrga jõu W ja Z bosonitele (ja seotud seotuse kaudu fermionidele), mitte universaalne massiandev protsess, mis rakendub kõigele.
